summary: 1937 CCC-built 110-ft Aermotor lookout in Cass County, MN; staffed until 1990, later emergency use and a radio repeater (undated, one history site); no public-access source.

facts.design: 110-foot Aermotor steel tower with a 7 by 7 foot metal cab

staffing.status: regular fire-season staffing ended in 1990; one history site says it is now used on an emergency basis (undated)

events.note: Built by the CCC with the Minnesota Division of Forestry (NHLR) or the Minnesota DNR (Historical Minnesota Fire Towers); Forest Lookouts also dates it 1937
Staffed regularly during fire season until 1990

corrections.why: The NHLR entry and the Historical Minnesota Fire Towers page both give 110 feet (33.5 m); the 100-foot (30.5 m) figure appears only on the Forest Lookouts page.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts gives 100 feet (30.5 m); NHLR and the Historical Minnesota Fire Towers page give 110 feet (33.5 m). The story and facts use 110 feet because two sources agree on it.

notes_for_editor: Public access is unknown: no source says whether visitors may climb it. Emergency use and the radio repeater rest on one hobbyist history page and are undated; I did not confirm them with an agency. A RadioReference forum post about a 158.8125 repeater on Ben Draper Forest Road was not used because it is old and not tied to this tower. The record's existing photos cover this tower; no new photos were added. Access block omitted because level is unknown.
